fact: The NRA has begun stakeholder consultations at the Jendema border crossing as it prepares to launch ASYCUDA World there, to automate import, export and transit regimes, with no launch date stated.
The NRA ASYCUDA Unit supervisor says ASYCUDA++ was introduced at Queen Elizabeth II Quay in 2009 and upgraded to the web-based ASYCUDA World in 2017.
The NRA ASYCUDA Unit supervisor says ASYCUDA World connects multiple agencies through digital modules, routing information by each institution's role.
The Anti-Corruption Commission report, per the Telegraph, found customs declarations deleted from the ASYCUDA system after payment, and notes real-time payment visibility within the ASYCUDA platform.
The Anti-Corruption Commission report states clearing agents' payments for ASYCUDA transactions were recorded in the NRA tax system, and refers to the ASYCUDA World System.
State House reports UNCTAD's Secretary-General committed on 21 January 2026 to fast-track assistance for upgrading Sierra Leone's ASYCUDA system.
